## What We Did



## Key Concepts

**Localized Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA)**
LISA refers to the spatial statistics used to measure the degree of spatial autocorrelation and clustering around individual locations on map. Clusters of high-high (individual-cluster) and low-low (individual-cluster) suggests that there is a pocket of space the model under or overestimates. If there are clusters of high-low or low-high, then that suggests that there are individual outliers within the clusters.


**Contiguity Matrices**
Queen contiguity refers to any polygons that border each other, either directly or across. Rook contiguity refers to any polygons that directly borders another.
